description: Burn synth held by the account to reduce its debt. "all" repays the whole debt. For the owner only: works with every session key revoked, ignores session limits, and still follows the market's rules. It prepares exactly this one market call and nothing else. Returns UNSIGNED transaction data for the owner's own wallet; simulated first and refused if it would revert. Never signs or sends.

market.description: Market address (0x...) or symbol, e.g. NO-NVDA

owner.description: The account's owner, who will send it (0x...). Refused for any other address

tokens.description: Synth to repay as a decimal string, or "all"

name: prepare_mandate_owner_repay
title: Prepare owner repay
